newsitem.title: USA: Extended Stay to buy Studio Plus.
newsitem.headline: Extended Stay to buy Studio Plus.

text.p: Extended Stay America Inc and Studio Plus Hotels Inc said early on Friday they had agreed to a stock-swap merger valued at about $290 million.

Under the deal, Extended Stay America will issue 1.2272 shares of its common stock for each of the approximately 12.5 million issued and outstanding shares of Studio Plus, the companies said in a joint statement.
The transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, the companies said.
Norwood Cowgill, chairman and chief executive officer of Studio Plus, will joint Extended Stay's board and will continue as chief executive officer of Studio Plus, the companies said.
The agreement is subject to the approval of shareholders of the companies and other customary terms and conditions and is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 1997, the companies said.
Studio Plus currently has 35 operating hotels, 11 hotels under construction and options to purchase 28 sites. The company had previously announced plans to have 65 operating hotels by year-end 1997.
Extended Stay America has 40 properties in 16 states, 50 properties under construction in 26 states and has options to buy 106 sites in 30 states.
